notes.title: The steam workshop function has been opened for testing!
notes.content:
The creative workshop function has been released to meet everyone. It is currently [b][u]beta version[/u][/b]. Welcome to upload pictures to participate! The programmer couldn't bear it after staying up for a few days and nights. He has already gone on vacation, so DEBUG will have to wait until next weekend. If you encounter problems with the test, you can add the group 814819327 to contact the group owner, and we will fix it as soon as possible.
 In addition, we plan to launch a reward themed activity [/u][/b] after the [b][u]creative workshop is officially launched, that is, we will release the picture theme of the week in the announcement, and the number of subscribers will be the most at the end of the week will receive corresponding rewards.
